purpose: Separate evidence that bounded professional/service work began, deliverables were delivered, customer deliverables were accepted, payment was observed, and the engagement completed without promoting one state into another or into revenue/legal/runtime conclusions.

required_evidence: SERVICE_DELIVERY_AUTHORIZED for exact engagement/offering/proposal scope
authentic attributable evidence that bounded work actually commenced
commencement timestamp or bounded work-event coordinate
no unresolved offering-specific stop/start condition
exact engagement and deliverable identity
deliverable version/hash or equivalent stable identity where applicable
authentic delivery/transmission/availability evidence attributable to the intended customer/review surface
delivery timestamp

CUSTOMER_DELIVERABLE_ACCEPTED.owner: customer/counterpart acceptance evidence owner under exact offering acceptance semantics
required_evidence: exact delivered artifact/deliverable identity
authentic customer/counterpart acceptance evidence attributable to the applicable acceptance mechanism
acceptance semantics satisfied for the offering/review period
unresolved correction/rejection condition absent or explicitly resolved

owner_refs: StegVerse-Labs/StegBusiness docs/RECORD_DOMAINS.md Finance receivable/revenue record references
required_evidence: authentic provider/financial evidence of payment or receivable settlement
amount/currency attributable to the exact engagement/invoice/payment obligation
receipt/reconciliation evidence

owner_refs: applicable offering fulfillment owner and accepted engagement completion terms
StegVerse-Labs/StegBusiness-Ops contracts/README.md only where separate contract lifecycle COMPLETE is applicable
required_evidence: exact engagement identity
all accepted in-scope deliverables/obligations required for engagement completion are satisfied or explicitly resolved
all required customer review/acceptance/correction conditions for engagement completion are satisfied
all explicit stop/change/open-item conditions are closed, waived by authorized evidence, or carried forward under a separately identified successor obligation
accountable offering owner records attributable completion evidence
does_not_prove: StegBusiness-Ops contract COMPLETE unless separately transitioned
ENGAGEMENT_COMPLETE.closure_independence: Independent of StegBusiness-Ops contract COMPLETE, EXPIRED, accounting close, payment, repository closure and legal discharge.

topology.rule: States are evidence-distinct and are not automatically transitive.
topology.authorized_to_begun: SERVICE_DELIVERY_AUTHORIZED permits bounded work to begin but is not evidence that work began.
topology.begun_to_delivered: DELIVERY_BEGUN does not imply a deliverable exists or was delivered.
topology.delivered_to_accepted: DELIVERABLE_DELIVERED does not imply customer acceptance.
topology.accepted_vs_payment: CUSTOMER_DELIVERABLE_ACCEPTED and PAYMENT_OBSERVED are independent unless exact accepted terms expressly make one a prerequisite for another.
topology.complete: ENGAGEMENT_COMPLETE is an ICV commercial closure evidence state. Its closure contract may resolve COMPLETE, COMPLETE_WITH_SUCCESSOR_OBLIGATION, TERMINATED or FAIL_CLOSED; contract lifecycle and accounting close remain separate.
topology.accounting: Revenue recognition is a separate accounting-basis determination under StegBusiness/StegBusiness-Ops finance records and is not created by any state in this contract.
topology.contract_lifecycle: StegBusiness-Ops contract COMPLETE remains a separate contract-lifecycle transition where applicable.

offering_acceptance_binding.icv.governance-assessment.v1: Customer confirms receipt/acceptance or supplies consolidated factual corrections within written review period; operational authorization is not implied.
offering_acceptance_binding.icv.governance-boundary-validation.v1: Completion requires reproducible agreed artifacts and explained findings without implying production approval/certification.
offering_acceptance_binding.icv.admitted-code.v1: Acceptance requires agreed candidate/evidence matrix and findings delivered reproducibly; deployment authorization is not implied.
offering_acceptance_binding.icv.steggate.v1: Acceptance requires agreed candidate evaluation and reproducible disposition/evidence; production authority is not implied.
offering_acceptance_binding.icv.stegcrm.v1: Acceptance requires bounded projection/reconciliation output with source authority/evidence lineage preserved and projection authority NONE.
offering_acceptance_binding.icv.hydrasafe.v1: Deliverable accepted when customer confirms receipt and approves next review stage or supplies consolidated correction list; no regulatory/engineering/operational approval implied.
offering_acceptance_binding.icv.gp10-field-validation.v1: Fulfillment terminates in evidence packet/receipt and customer review; payment and field conclusions remain separate.
offering_acceptance_binding.icv.governance-observatory.v1: Complete when agreed observation/evaluation artifacts are delivered with provenance/publication boundaries and unresolved fields explicit.
offering_acceptance_binding.icv.knowledgevault.v1: Complete when agreed file-based vault is delivered/initialized, applicable integrity checks pass and customer can inspect agreed structure/receipts.
offering_acceptance_binding.icv.stegtalk.v1: Complete when agreed local prototype scenario is demonstrated and candidate status/evidence/gaps are delivered.
offering_acceptance_binding.icv.ecosystem-chat.v1: Complete when agreed scenario is mapped through released source-positioning contract and implemented-vs-unproven evidence is delivered.
offering_acceptance_binding.icv.steglearn.v1: Complete when agreed learning loop produces a reviewable receipt/portfolio record and parent/steward can accept, correct or decline the evidence.
